verdict.rationale: Fellow documents natural-language questions about meetings, including decision questions like "What did we decide in last month's standup?". However, the documented path runs through its first-party MCP Server and an external AI assistant (Claude, ChatGPT, Cursor). The native "Ask Fellow" feature appears only as a pricing-page line item, and transcripts are described as searchable. missing for 10: evidence that answers include source citations or links back to meetings, documentation of native in-app Ask Fellow Q&A depth, confirmation of coverage across the entire meeting history, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a product manager, I can ask questions in natural language across my whole meeting history ("what did we decide about pricing?") and get answers with sources

citations.quote: Ask anything about your meetings - Get answers to questions like "What were my action items this week?" or "What did we decide in last month's standup?"
Fellow's Model Context Protocol (MCP) Server allows you to ask your AI Assistant about your meetings, without needing to write any code.
Every conversation becomes searchable through a full transcript, giving your team instant access to past context whenever they need it.
